Done:
- Diagnosis: item 1 is a WebKit DRAWING bug, not measurement. WebKit paints the .is-paged .editor-paper repeating-linear-gradient (src/editor/editor.css ~452) with unzoomed px stops, so grey gaps are drawn every 1056/1088 screen px at any zoom. Spacers are correct (native starts 0 px at 75/50). 1.png is reproduced natively at 50 % (ui4-g1/native-screens/zoom-50-top.png). 3.png is reproduced natively at fit zoom 0.826 (ui4-g1/native-screens2/gap-caret-a.png): the caret is on page 2's real text but drawn inside the misplaced grey band.
- Chromium: pages-gap.spec.ts passes all 9 (3 seeds); pages-zoom.spec.ts fails only at fit zoom 1.1495 (125/150 % at 1240 px): drift up to 4 px, 10 crossings.
- Files: tests/pages-helpers.ts, tests/pages-zoom.spec.ts, tests/pages-gap.spec.ts (new); tests/native-smoke.js gains a pages-zoom phase (pages-probe is byte-identical; backup at node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui4-g1/native-smoke.orig.js); node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui4-g/native-gate.py (adds --phase and a PNG pixel scan).
- Commands: Chromium: npx playwright test -c node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui4-g1/browser.config.mjs tests/pages-gap.spec.ts tests/pages-zoom.spec.ts (dist ui4-g1/dist, port 1641; summarise with python3 ui4-g1/report.py <report>). Native: ui4-g1/smoke-build.sh, then python3 ui4-g/native-gate.py --binary g1=<abs>/ui4-g1/bin/folio-g1 --runs 1 (take serial-check.lock first). Logs: ui4-g1/pw-both.log, native-gate2.log, native-gate3.log.

Next (first concrete action): read the answer to Q019 and the coordinator's reply. If G1 is accepted as is, run done T171 with the evidence above. If G2 is re-planned toward fixing the drawing, the native gate's pixel deltas (deltaTop/deltaBottom within 2 px at every zoom) are the fail-first check.
Do not redo: the native runs, the Chromium runs, or the PNG decoder.
Open contradiction: plan G1 step 4 says a click in the gap's upper half goes to page 1's end; tests/pages.spec.ts says split+16 goes to page 2's start. The spec keeps the existing behaviour.

(3) G2 as written (measure at zoom 1) would break WebKit, whose line heights change with zoom. (4) Acceptance 'pages-gap.spec fails on untouched tree' cannot be met; failing checks are pages-zoom.spec (Chromium fit zoom 1.1495 drift up to 4 px, 10 crossings) and the native gate pixels. Questions: confirm 3.png was a narrow window/split pane; re-plan G2 toward fixing the paper drawing (plus the small Chromium drift); how is G1 accepted?
